description: Defines a Flutter widget for a payment method selection bottom sheet, providing quick access to various payment apps via deep links and handling cases where apps are not installed.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a bottom sheet with payment options such as Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Builds a list tile for a payment option with icon, name, color, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch a payment app via a deep link URI; shows a message if the app is not installed.
